findings.title: Timestamp quantization active
findings.evidence: gpu-quantized precision should not treat sub-0.2ms deltas as meaningful.
findings.recommendation: Enable developer timing flags when investigating very small shader regressions.
findings.safeClaim: Large pass-level movements can be compared under gpu-quantized precision.
findings.blockedClaim: Sub-0.2ms regression claims remain blocked under gpu-quantized precision.
findings.nextExperiment: Recapture with gpu-exact precision before acting on small deltas.

findings.title: Repeated transient resource rows
findings.evidence: depthBuffer appears 238 time(s) as transient texture API metadata.
findings.recommendation: Pool or reuse the repeated resource for one capture, then compare resource rows and timing.
findings.safeClaim: depthBuffer appears as repeated transient API resource metadata.
findings.blockedClaim: This does not prove VRAM residency, heap pressure, driver allocation cost, or memory bandwidth saturation.
findings.nextExperiment: Reuse or pool depthBuffer for one capture, then compare resource rows and timing.
